name: wallos-mcp
description: Your Wallos subscription tracker on a Cloudflare Worker you deploy yourself: list, create, edit and delete subscriptions, categories, payment methods, household members and currencies, over MCP
author: mkpoli

scripts.check: biome check src test scripts && tsc --noEmit

COOKIE_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Random 32 bytes as hex, from `openssl rand -hex 32`. It signs the approval cookie the sign-in flow sets.

ALLOWED_HOSTS.description: Which Wallos instances a connection may bind to: a comma-separated list of hosts, *.your-domain.com, or * for any host. Empty means none.
